method.price: Minimum, maximum and unweighted arithmetic mean of all market quote prices; not executed prices.
method.harvest: Closing cumulativeHarvested minus initial cumulativeHarvested (source cells, not market output).
method.flows: Sum interval units and value by direction:category. Value is a stock valuation, not cash paid.
method.sourceSamples: Full runner outputs are not committed. Their SHA-256 is recorded; compact monthly observations and totals follow.
method.scope: Same input and climate fixture as beforeReport, with all orchard model corrections applied together; not a single-factor price experiment.

notes: Flows value goods at recorded market prices; these are not household cash payments.
Market stock excludes source-cell food reserves. Harvest includes actual source-cell use before market intake.
Purchase sink categories, global deals and physical departure legs are separate observations.
Orchard hectares are selected area before staffing, not a guarantee of harvested output.

fixture.note: Controlled precipitation fixture, not an unmodified generated map. No stock, recipes, prices or labour injected.
